title: Astra's Stat Boosters
description: Exchange experience levels for consumable that give stat buffs upon use.
body:
# **DESCRIPTION**

This datapack allows players that have 30 levels or more to spend five levels to obtain one of seven different stat boosters using a trigger command.

These stat boosters, referred to in-game as Constellation Fragments, are single-use consumable items that will boost a specified stat until death or willful removal with the provided trigger or function commands listed below. Constellation Fragments are used with a simple right click. Up to five of each type may be used, resulting in stronger buffs the more you stack them. Attempting to use more than the maximum amount of fragments will simply return the item to you alongside a message informing you that you're at the limit, so don't worry about wasting them on accident.

There's even a special reward for those who manage to max out every boostable stat. It's quite the grind, but if you can get it done, you'll receive the Complete Constellation, an item which will allow you to instantly reach max level for every stat when used, and never gets permanently consumed! I would advise keeping this item in a very safe place, such as your ender chest or something, as there will not be a way for the same player to get a new one without the use of commands.

## **CURRENT FEATURES**

**BOOSTABLE STATS**

- Attack
- Mining Speed
- Defense
- Luck
- Movement Speed
- Respiration
- Maximum Health

**NEW ADVANCEMENTS**

- **Constellation Master**: Maximize every boostable stat using Constellation Fragments. Acquiring this advancement gives the player a Complete Constellation item, which will increase every stat to the max level instantly, in case you happen to lose all that hard work.

**NOTABLE COMMANDS**

- **/trigger asb_retreive_attack_fragment**: Gives an attack boosting Constellation Fragment to you, provided you have at least thirty levels. Five of those levels will be consumed if the command is successful.
- **/trigger asb_retreive_mining_fragment**: Gives a mining speed boosting Constellation Fragment to you, provided you have at least thirty levels. Five of those levels will be consumed if the command is successful.
- **/trigger asb_retreive_defense_fragment**: Gives a defense boosting Constellation Fragment to you, provided you have at least thirty levels. Five of those levels will be consumed if the command is successful.
- **/trigger asb_retreive_luck_fragment**: Gives a luck boosting Constellation Fragment to you, provided you have at least thirty levels. Five of those levels will be consumed if the command is successful.
- **/trigger asb_retreive_speed_fragment**: Gives a movement speed boosting Constellation Fragment to you, provided you have at least thirty levels. Five of those levels will be consumed if the command is successful.
- **/trigger asb_retreive_respiration_fragment**: Gives a respiration boosting Constellation Fragment to you, provided you have at least thirty levels. Five of those levels will be consumed if the command is successful.
- **/trigger asb_retreive_health_fragment**: Gives a maximum health boosting Constellation Fragment to you, provided you have at least thirty levels. Five of those levels will be consumed if the command is successful.
- **/trigger asb_boost_check**: Displays how many stat boosters the user of the command currently has active.
- **/trigger asb_reset_boosts**: Removes any stat buffs the user of the command currently has. This does not return any stat boosters or experience levels. Not sure why I added this, to be honest.
- **/function stat_boosters:receive_ultimate_booster**: Gives the user of the command the Complete Constellation item without the need to complete the advancement it's tied to.
- **/function stat_boosters:reset_all_stats**: Removes all stat buffs from every player. Again, I doubt many people will need this command, but it's here in case someone does.

**SUPPORTED LANGUAGES**

- English
- Spanish
- French

### **OTHER THINGS**

There is a required resource pack for this datapack, please be sure to download it as well!

The most recent version of this datapack was designed for version 1.21.5, however I have confirmed that it works without issue in all currently existing future versions.

This pack is intended to get a 3.0 update soon enough, hopefully returning the pack back to its original vision of being related to the End dimension.
